items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because we were talking about the trombone with Ahmer. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Che.

ctx.x: Yeah I appreciate that, just to say hi. We go way back, that would be nice. I think I saw him once since he has been in town, but it’s been a while so I’d like to.
